name: nfdi.software
description: The nfdi.software project develops a central marketplace for research software within the German National Research Data Infrastructure (NFDI). It harvests, standardises, and enriches metadata from NFDI consortia marketplaces and registries, links software to data and other research artefacts, and applies AI-driven approaches to monitor software relevance. The initialisation phase delivered a proof-of-concept website and API, a prototype for integration with tools such as the Research Software Directory and bio.tools, and work towards a cross-sector metadata vocabulary. At ZB MED, the Semantic Technologies team contributed to metadata exchange with other Base4NFDI services, quality criteria and metadata alignment (including CodeMeta and FAIR4RS), and recommendations for curating software added to the marketplace.
